title: Add Side Lengths to Calculate Perimeter

instruction.text: Which sum should you use to work out the perimeter of the shape below? Select the correct answer.

hint.text: Perimeter is the total distance around a shape. You work out perimeter by adding all the sides together.

instruction.text: What is the perimeter of the shape? Write the correct answer.

atoms.finishSound: The perimeter of the shape is 20.
